messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage A:
"""
Critical Illness), then financial projection/ Sensitivity Analysis has to be furnished afresh along with each of the products under which the said Add-on is proposed to be offered. This is because the financial projections for the Add-on may differ under that product. For instance, the financial projections submitted for Add-on A along with product X need not be the same when the same Addon A is offered along with product Y. As such the financial projections / Sensitivity Analysis need to be furnished for the said Add-on along with each product in the specified sections. It may be noted that Addon details need not be mentioned again but only the financial projections are to be filed, when the same Add-on is offered along with the second or the third product.
"""

Passage B:
"""
3.7 Specify Non-forfeiture conditions [When the contract would be not null and void] 3.8 Specify options available under the product. (e.g. to increase or decrease benefits, plan changes, etc.) [This section should specify the various options available under the product. The charges, if any, towards the cost of the option shall also be specified. ] 3.9 Furnish complete information on already approved add-ons, proposed to be attached with this product if any 3.9.1 Add-ons attached to the product S.N o Add-on Name UIN allotted by IRDAI Date of clearance 3.9.2 Any other features that may be relevant for the product.
"""

Write ONE question whose full answer needs a fact from Passage A AND a fact from Passage B (e.g. combine two rules, or apply one rule to the situation in the other). If no natural question needs both, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts_a": [1-3 word-for-word spans from A], "facts_b": [1-3 word-for-word spans from B], "sub_queries": [a short search query for A's fact, a short search query for B's fact]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If a policyholder wants to add a new add‑on to an existing product, what financial documentation must the insurer submit for each product, and what additional product‑level information must be included in the application?","answer":"The insurer must provide a fresh financial projection or sensitivity analysis for the add‑on with each product it is offered under, and must also specify the non‑forfeiture conditions and any options available for the product, including charges for those options.","facts_a":["financial projection/ Sensitivity Analysis has to be furnished afresh along with each of the products"],"facts_b":["Specify Non‑forfeiture conditions","Specify options available under the product"],"sub_queries":["financial projection Sensitivity Analysis for add‑on","non‑forfeiture conditions options available"]}]}
